entries.en: You either sell my supply, or I'll find another way for you to make me eddies. Got it?
entries.ro: Ori vinzi marfa mea, ori îmi găsesc altă metodă să-mi faci eddies. Pricepi?

entries.en: Better sell all this shit, or you'll be sleepin' outside tonight! You hear me, you fuckin' bum?!
entries.ro: Mai bine vinzi tot rahatul ăsta, altfel dormi pe stradă diseară! M-ai auzit, nenorocitule?
